import zipfile, os, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
ET.register_namespace('', NS)

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
TMP = 'sales_data_new.xlsx'

zin = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC, 'r')
zout = zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as z:
    sheet_xml = z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml')
sroot = ET.fromstring(sheet_xml)

def cell_val(row, col):
    for c in row.findall(f'{{{NS}}}c'):
        if c.get('r') == f'{col}{row.get("r")}':
            v = c.find(f'{{{NS}}}v')
            return float(v.text) if v is not None and v.text else None
    return None

sd = sroot.find(f'{{{NS}}}sheetData')
cached = {}
for row in sd.findall(f'{{{NS}}}row'):
    r = int(row.get('r'))
    if 2 <= r <= 9:
        units = cell_val(row, 'C')
        price = cell_val(row, 'D')
        cost = cell_val(row, 'F')
        e = units * price
        g = e - units * cost
        cached[r] = (e, g)
tot_e = sum(v[0] for v in cached.values())
tot_g = sum(v[1] for v in cached.values())

for item in zin.infolist():
    data = zin.read(item.filename)

    if item.filename == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
        root = ET.fromstring(data)
        root.find(f'{{{NS}}}dimension').set('ref', 'A1:H10')
        cols = root.find(f'{{{NS}}}cols')
        col = ET.SubElement(cols, f'{{{NS}}}col')
        col.set('width', '14'); col.set('customWidth', '1'); col.set('min', '8'); col.set('max', '8')
        sd = root.find(f'{{{NS}}}sheetData')
        for row in sd.findall(f'{{{NS}}}row'):
            r = int(row.get('r'))
            c = ET.SubElement(row, f'{{{NS}}}c')
            if r == 1:
                c.set('r', 'H1'); c.set('s', '1'); c.set('t', 'inlineStr')
                is_ = ET.SubElement(c, f'{{{NS}}}is')
                t = ET.SubElement(is_, f'{{{NS}}}t')
                t.text = 'Profit Margin %'
            elif 2 <= r <= 9:
                c.set('r', f'H{r}'); c.set('s', '3')
                ET.SubElement(c, f'{{{NS}}}f').text = f'G{r}/E{r}'
                ET.SubElement(c, f'{{{NS}}}v').text = repr(cached[r][1] / cached[r][0])
            elif r == 10:
                c.set('r', 'H10'); c.set('s', '3')
                ET.SubElement(c, f'{{{NS}}}f').text = 'G10/E10'
                ET.SubElement(c, f'{{{NS}}}v').text = repr(tot_g / tot_e)
        data = ET.tostring(root, xml_declaration=True, encoding='UTF-8')

    elif item.filename == 'xl/styles.xml':
        root = ET.fromstring(data)
        numFmts = root.find(f'{{{NS}}}numFmts')
        numFmts.set('count', '1')
        nf = ET.SubElement(numFmts, f'{{{NS}}}numFmt')
        nf.set('numFmtId', '164'); nf.set('formatCode', '0.0%')
        cellXfs = root.find(f'{{{NS}}}cellXfs')
        cellXfs.set('count', '4')
        xf = ET.SubElement(cellXfs, f'{{{NS}}}xf')
        xf.set('numFmtId', '164'); xf.set('fontId', '0'); xf.set('fillId', '0')
        xf.set('borderId', '0'); xf.set('xfId', '0'); xf.set('applyNumberFormat', '1')
        data = ET.tostring(root, xml_declaration=True, encoding='UTF-8')
